# Generated by tools/build_sect_content.py.
ac_sect_random_identity_effect = {
	random_list = {
		1 = { trigger = { NOT = { any_in_global_list = { variable = ac_sects var:ac_identity ?= flag:thunderfall } } } set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:thunderfall } }
		1 = { trigger = { NOT = { any_in_global_list = { variable = ac_sects var:ac_identity ?= flag:sunbringer } } } set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:sunbringer } }
		1 = { trigger = { NOT = { any_in_global_list = { variable = ac_sects var:ac_identity ?= flag:mountain_hazard } } } set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:mountain_hazard } }
		1 = { trigger = { NOT = { any_in_global_list = { variable = ac_sects var:ac_identity ?= flag:dreamriver } } } set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:dreamriver } }
		1 = { trigger = { NOT = { any_in_global_list = { variable = ac_sects var:ac_identity ?= flag:waverunner } } } set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:waverunner } }
		1 = { trigger = { NOT = { any_in_global_list = { variable = ac_sects var:ac_identity ?= flag:lost_siren } } } set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:lost_siren } }

		1 = { trigger = { NOT = { any_in_global_list = { variable = ac_sects var:ac_identity ?= flag:wandering_tear } } } set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:wandering_tear } }
		1 = { trigger = { NOT = { any_in_global_list = { variable = ac_sects var:ac_identity ?= flag:alluvial_fan } } } set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:alluvial_fan } }

		1 = { trigger = { NOT = { any_in_global_list = { variable = ac_sects var:ac_identity ?= flag:saints_vigil } } } set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:saints_vigil } }
		1 = { trigger = { NOT = { any_in_global_list = { variable = ac_sects var:ac_identity ?= flag:endless_daylight } } } set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:endless_daylight } }
		1 = { trigger = { NOT = { any_in_global_list = { variable = ac_sects var:ac_identity ?= flag:great_arena } } } set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:great_arena } }
		1 = { trigger = { NOT = { any_in_global_list = { variable = ac_sects var:ac_identity ?= flag:heavenly_ascension } } } set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:heavenly_ascension } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_identity } }
		random_list = {
			1 = { set_variable = { name = ac_identity value = flag:thunderfall } }

# Story scope, once the name is known: Trade Sects are marked for their richer income.
ac_sect_mark_kind_effect = {
	if = { limit = { OR = { var:ac_identity = flag:choral_line var:ac_identity = flag:thousand_lantern var:ac_identity = flag:shielded_hull var:ac_identity = flag:scarlet_sun var:ac_identity = flag:forbidden_field } } set_variable = { name = ac_trade_sect value = 1 } }
}

ac_sect_teach_identity_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:thunderfall }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_foundation_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_foundation_tiger }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_martial_style_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_style_midorikatai }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_element_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_element_storm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:sunbringer }
		if = { limit = { ac_has_foundation_trigger = no } add_trait = ac_foundation_dragon }

ac_sect_teach_second_element_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:thunderfall ac_element_count < 2 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = ac_element_earth } } add_trait = ac_element_earth }
		else = { add_trait = ac_element_storm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:sunbringer ac_element_count < 2 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = ac_element_fire } } add_trait = ac_element_fire }
		else = { add_trait = ac_element_light }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:mountain_hazard ac_element_count < 2 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = ac_element_earth } } add_trait = ac_element_earth }
		else = { add_trait = ac_element_ice }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:dreamriver ac_element_count < 2 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = ac_element_water } } add_trait = ac_element_water }
		else = { add_trait = ac_element_fire }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:waverunner ac_element_count < 2 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = ac_element_ice } } add_trait = ac_element_ice }
		else = { add_trait = ac_element_water }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:lost_siren ac_element_count < 2 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = ac_element_ice } } add_trait = ac_element_ice }
		else = { add_trait = ac_element_water }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:endless_beating ac_element_count < 2 }

		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = ac_element_light } } add_trait = ac_element_light }
		else = { add_trait = ac_element_fire }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:shielded_hull ac_element_count < 2 }

		limit = { var:ac_sect.var:ac_identity = flag:endless_daylight ac_element_count < 2 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = ac_element_storm } } add_trait = ac_element_storm }
		else = { add_trait = ac_element_light }

	if = {

		else = { add_trait = ac_element_earth }
	}
	if = {

		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = ac_element_fire } } add_trait = ac_element_fire }

# A small opening remains in both ranks for players and subsequent recruitment.
ac_sect_seed_roster_effect = {
	var:ac_sect = { save_scope_as = ac_seeded_sect }
	while = {
		count = ac_sect_initial_upper
		ac_sect_seed_disciple_effect = { RANK = upper }
	}
	while = {
		count = ac_sect_initial_lower
		ac_sect_seed_disciple_effect = { RANK = lower }
	}
	var:ac_sect = { ac_sect_recount_effect = yes }
}
ac_sect_seed_disciple_effect = {
	create_character = {
		gender_female_chance = 50
		age = { 20 38 }
		culture = this.culture
		faith = this.faith
		location = scope:ac_seeded_sect.var:ac_headquarters
		random_traits = yes
		save_scope_as = ac_seeded_member
	}
	scope:ac_seeded_member = {
		set_variable = { name = ac_sect value = scope:ac_seeded_sect }
		set_variable = { name = ac_sect_contribution value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = ac_sect_merit value = 0 }
		add_trait = ac_cultivator
		add_trait = ac_sect_$RANK$_disciple
		ac_sect_teach_identity_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = ac_sect_upper_disciple }
			set_variable = { name = ac_sect_merit value = 150 }
			ac_sect_teach_second_element_effect = yes
			ac_sect_develop_rank_effect = yes
		}
		else = { ac_sect_develop_rank_effect = yes }
	}
	scope:ac_seeded_sect = { add_to_variable_list = { name = ac_members target = scope:ac_seeded_member } }
}
